john.7.p1.b1.text: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.

john.7.p1.b2.text: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.

john.7.p1.b3.text: “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing. … Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”

john.7.p1.b4.text: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.

john.7.p2.b1.text: “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.

john.7.p2.b2.text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.

john.7.p2.b3.text: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”

john.7.p2.b4.text: Having said this, Jesus remained in Galilee.

john.7.p3.b1.text: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, He also went—not publicly, but in secret.

john.7.p4.b1.text: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.

john.7.p4.b2.text: “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”

john.7.p4.b3.text: “My teaching is not My own,” … “It comes from Him who sent Me.

john.7.p4.b4.text: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.

john.7.p5.b1.text: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”

john.7.p5.b2.text: “You have a demon,” … “Who is trying to kill You?”

john.7.p5.b3.text: … why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?

john.7.p5.b4.text: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”

john.7.p6.b1.text: “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?

john.7.p6.b2.text: Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?

john.7.p6.b3.text: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”

john.7.p7.b1.text: “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,

john.7.p7.b2.text: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.

john.7.p7.b3.text: “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”

john.7.p8.b1.text: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.

john.7.p8.b2.text: “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.

john.7.p8.b3.text: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”

john.7.p8.b4.text: “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him?

john.7.p9.b1.text: On the last and greatest day of the feast,

john.7.p9.b2.text: “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.

john.7.p9.b3.text: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”

john.7.p9.b4.text: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive.

john.7.p10.b3.text: “How can the Christ come from Galilee? Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?”

john.7.p10.b4.text: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus.

john.7.p10.b5.text: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.

john.7.p11.b1.text: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees,

john.7.p11.b3.text: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!”

john.7.p12.b1.text: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?

john.7.p12.b2.text: But this crowd that does not know the law, they are under a curse.”

john.7.p12.b3.text: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them, asked,

john.7.p12.b4.text: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”

john.7.p13.b2.text: “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
